comments.agent_turn_limit: Agents have already spoken {turns} times in a row in this thread: {agents} won't be launched until a person writes.
comments.mention_no_prompt: @{agent} can't answer: it has no prompt loaded (neither `prompts/mention.md` nor `prompts/main.md`). Load one in **Agents → {agent}** and mention it again.

errors.agent_index_agents_only: only an agent run files its run index
errors.agent_needs_repo: Agent {agent:%q} needs a linked repo. Link a project, pick another agent, or mark this agent as works_without_repo.
errors.archive_subtask: A subtask is archived with its parent task: archive the parent.
errors.auditor_feedback_auditor_only: only the auditor's run files auditor feedback
errors.auditor_instance_mismatch: instance must be this auditor's own run
errors.blocked_by_dependencies: The task waits on blocking dependencies. Move every blocker to {stages} first.
errors.boards_disagree: the linked projects default to different boards ({boards}) — pass board_id to choose one
errors.comment_not_on_task: comment_id is not a comment on this task
errors.daemon_owned_fields: these fields are set by the daemon and cannot be patched: {fields}
errors.delete_subtasks_first: This task has subtasks. They share its sandbox and working copy: delete them first, or delete the task together with them.
errors.depends_on_not_sibling: depends_on must reference a sibling subtask of the same parent
errors.hard_dep_after_initial: A blocking dependency can only be added while the task is in {stage}. Move it back first, or add the dependency as a heads-up (kind 'soft').
errors.index_not_positive: index must be a positive integer
errors.limit_not_positive: limit must be a positive integer
errors.instance_not_of_task: instance_id must be a run of this task
errors.message_not_from_person: only a message a person wrote can be moved to the comments
errors.no_linked_projects: task has no linked projects — nothing to push or open a PR for
errors.stage_missing_on_board: stage {stage:%q} does not exist on board {board:%q} — pass a stage to move the task into
errors.stage_skipped_by_type: stage {stage:%q} is skipped by task type {type:%q} — re-type the task or pick another stage
errors.subtask_of_subtask: Cannot create a subtask of a subtask — the hierarchy is one level deep. Add it under the parent task instead.
errors.subtask_order_incomplete: The order must list every subtask of this task exactly once. Missing or repeated: {ids}
errors.subtask_order_not_child: {id} is not a subtask of this task. List only its subtasks.
errors.type_skips_stage: task type {type:%q} skips stage {stage:%q} — pass a stage to move the task into
errors.merge_conflict: the task branch conflicts with the target branch
errors.merge_conflict_files: {count} files conflict with {target}; nothing was merged
errors.merge_no_upload_project: the task has no uploaded project to merge into; a project cloned from a repository gets a pull request instead
errors.merge_pick_project: the task has several uploaded projects; say which one in project_id
errors.merge_nothing: branch {branch} has no commits to merge yet
errors.section_not_found: the task body has no section {section:%q}

hints.answers_in_chat: **{agent}** answers in its chat about this task.
hints.chat_failed_answers_in_comments: Could not open the chat of **{agent}**; I asked it through a mention and it answers in the comments.
hints.no_chat_answers_in_comments: **{agent}** has no chat; I asked it through a mention and it answers in the comments.

log.initial_stage_failed: handleCreateTask: cannot set initial stage {stage:%q} on {task}: {err}
log.list_children_before_delete: api: list children before delete for task {task}
log.mention_skipped_no_prompt: mention for {task} skipped: agent {agent:%q} has no prompt ({err})
log.merge_comment: write the merge comment on task {task}
log.merge_event: record the merge event on task {task}
log.not_removing_not_run_output: not removing {path}: not a run output dir
log.note_turn_limit: note agent turn limit on task {task}
log.open_task_chat: open task chat for @{agent} on task {task}
log.persist_fork_worktrees: api: persist worktree paths for fork {task}
log.remove_task_run_output: api: remove run output {name} of task {task}
log.remove_worktree: api: remove worktree for task {task} in project {project}
log.resolve_clone_credential: api: resolve the GitHub credential to fetch project {project}
log.task_breakdown: read the cost breakdown of task {task}

prompts.brief_audit_no_report: The run left no report. Its comments, if any, are in the discussion above.
prompts.brief_board_note: Tasks you create through the `octopus-api` MCP land on this board. Writing to another board is a separate tool, which your agent config may not grant.
prompts.brief_repos_intro: Each repo is mounted at `/workspace/projects/<name>/` once the task leaves its initial stage; before that there is no worktree. In a stage run you edit there and Thulu commits what you leave when the run ends. A mention or an auditor sees them read-only.
prompts.brief_test_cases_intro: These rows are the task's test cases; they supersede any Test Cases checklist in the description. Record results with `task_test_case_run`.
prompts.brief_repo_hosted: - **Repo:** uploaded to Thulu, no GitHub remote. Commit on the task branch and push to origin as usual; there is no pull request: a person lands the branch with Merge into.

timeline.dependent_removed: {task} no longer depends on this task
timeline.fork_worktree_stale_base: could not fetch the latest default branch from GitHub for project {project}; the fork's branch starts from commit {commit}, which may be behind GitHub: {err}
